brightness.label: Deck brightness
brightness.description: Default backlight level written to connected Stream Decks (1–100).

hidapi_path.label: hidapi library path
hidapi_path.description: Optional absolute path to libhidapi-hidraw.so. Leave empty on NixOS; the daemon uses /run/current-system/sw/lib/libhidapi-hidraw.so.0.

show_label.label: Show bar label
show_label.description: Show the Elgato Control name next to the bar icon.
